trigger: All eleven head-only candidates failed the fixed development recovery screens. No recovery policy fitting or final inference was performed.
scheduler: 30-step warmup then cosine from full rate to 0.1 of full rate
training_order: Shuffle all selected train observation groups with seed 271, retain each group together; checkpoint boundaries are group boundaries. All 9,129 previously declared train questions are used exactly once.
loss: Same corpus/family weights and frozen-temperature soft cross entropy as the head study. On workflow replay add 4*KL to the cached merged parent distribution at temperature 2. No teacher-error distillation on legacy rows.
memory: Activation checkpointing on trainable last six language layers only, nonreentrant; other adapters, base backbone, vision and condition_readout frozen. Fixed before training.

selection.rank: Eligible first; then minimum legacy text/image accuracy, workflow known/new macro accuracy, lower uncertainty NLL, smaller parameter movement; fixed candidate order breaks exact ties.

selection_procedure: Evaluate all three saved candidates with actual merged BF16 GPU inference on all 5,102 declared development rows; use unchanged readout-study recovery screens and ranking. Parent is a diagnostic reference. No final or new validation predictions enter selection.
followup_override: Replace the failed eleven-head-candidate selection with this prospectively declared three-candidate backbone recovery. Every original numerical release gate, new validation population, unused final family/data definition and no-refit rule stays fixed.
